name: Boracay Island
notes: World-famous beach destination, consistently ranked among the best beaches globally. Home to White Beach (4km powdery white sand).

name: Ati-Atihan Festival Grounds
notes: Site of the annual Ati-Atihan Festival (January), one of the Philippines' oldest and most vibrant cultural celebrations.

name: Jawili Falls
notes: Series of seven cascading pools with natural rock formations. A popular eco-tourism destination in Tangalan.

name: Bakhawan Eco-Park (Mangrove Forest)
notes: Community-based mangrove reforestation project covering over 216 hectares near Caticlan. Bamboo boardwalk through mangroves.

name: Buruanga Peninsula
notes: Scenic coastal area with beaches, fishing communities, and views of smaller islands. Emerging eco-tourism destination.

name: Punta Bunga Beach
notes: Secluded beach on the northern tip of Boracay island, accessible by tricycle and walk.

name: Nabas Eco-Tourism Sites
notes: Inland municipality with agri-tourism potential, waterfalls, and scenic mountain landscapes.

name: Ibajay Public Market & Heritage Sites
notes: Known for local products, heritage church, and coastal tourism. Gateway to some of Aklan's scenic coastal areas.

name: Lezo Hot Spring
notes: Natural hot spring in Lezo municipality near Kalibo. A local recreational attraction.

name: Makato Heritage Church
notes: Historic Spanish-era church and heritage site in Makato municipality.
